evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked. Rep jumps straight into probing: 'So I do have a moving you from 3400 Harmon Avenue and that's in Austin one bedroom apartment on the third floor, is that correct?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns raised by customer.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep states 'right now, we had you at about three to four hours estimated time' and later 'increase the reservation to about five and a half.' No typical range anchor for apartment size, no personalization to customer's specific concerns.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep says 'I will send over an updated estimate for you' and then pivots to 'Do you have any questions for me that I could answer for you?' — no closing ask for the business.

top_strength: Excellent logistics probing — rep systematically gathered detailed information about large items (L-shaped couch, 70-inch TVs, queen bed, desks, dressers, outdoor furniture), both locations' parking and elevator access, walking distances, TV mounting, and dresser drawer content, providing a thorough picture for the estimate.
coaching_note: This call skipped the foundational Section 1 quid-pro-quo framing, never asked for their concerns or agenda, provided no pricing framing (trip fees, minimums, increments), and critically never asked for the business — rep pivoted to 'sending an estimate' instead of closing the sale.
